newsitem.title: CHINA: China tin smelter '96 output falls to 3,500 T.
newsitem.headline: China tin smelter '96 output falls to 3,500 T.

text.p: China's flood-hit Liuzhou Smelter is on track to produce 3,500 tonnes of tin in 1996, down by 100 tonnes compared with 1995, a senior smelter official said.
"Tin production is expected to reach 3,500 tonnes this year. Output was 3,600 tonnes last year," he said by telephone from Liuzhou city in the southwestern Guangxi region.
"Mainly because of the floods we suspended production for one month from July 19 to August 20," he said. Full production was resumed on August 20.
Most major smelters in Liuzhou city had suspended production because of severe flooding in July that affected production and causing heavy economic losses.
The smelter has set a target of tin production of 3,500 tonnes for 1997, he said. "We cannot expand production because of the impact on the environment," he said.
About 90 percent of Liuzhou's tin output was for export, he said, but gave no further details.
